decisions.rationale: Clean break — JWT is sole identity source. route_layer prevents 404→401 bleed. from_fn_with_state gives AppState access for JWT public key. Grace period via response mutation.

decisions.decision: CallerIdentity extended with handle: String and session_id: Uuid
decisions.rationale: D-39 JWT claims include handle/name/sid. D-49 requires handle propagation via gRPC metadata. Single Extension covers all caller context.
